title: 3 Signs You’re Living Beyond Your Means

segments.text: You're likely living above your financial reality.
Do you often rely on credit to cover expenses?
That’s a warning sign you shouldn’t ignore.
It could lead to deeper financial issues down the line.
This isn’t just about spending habits—it’s a mindset.
Ready to regain control of your finances? Follow for tips.

description: Recognize the signs of living beyond means to protect your wealth. Follow for practical strategies to regain control. 📉
